_what: Runbook Phase 4 / plan §4.1 — block-SPECIES coverage, C-BLOCK's axis-1 obligation. The fact-statement species (f_script) is measured (S1 9/10 · P1a 9/10 · P3/P3b baselines 10/10). Spec I1 says the injection unit is ANY timeline/report sentence — so the channel's evidence must cover the other three species the spec names: emotion description, NPC quote, self-narration. At the S1 configuration, each species carries the same fear-axis claim about the caller (law #1 held constant, so a failure is a SPECIES failure, not vocabulary misalignment), each with its own matched bystander placebo. One fresh baseline is measured in-phase per the runbook, not reused from Phase 1.

_authoring_provenance.ported_from: S1-stanceset-J1.json — slots, gate question, stance set, temperament, base byte-identical. Only BLOCKS vary, one block per non-baseline arm.
_authoring_provenance.arm_layout: Seven arms in one suite: baseline + (live, placebo) × 3 species. One suite rather than three so the single in-phase baseline is shared under an enforced arm-diff, exactly as the runbook orders ('re-run the baseline once in this phase'). The harness accepts arbitrary arm names; the missing literal 'placebo' arm warning is expected and spurious — every species has its matched placebo.
species_construction: EMOTION DESCRIPTION (em_): third-person symptom prose, no propositional claim about coercion — the species differs from f_script precisely in asserting a state rather than a fact-with-cause. Fear axis explicit (겁먹은·떨린다) per law #1; caller named as 회선 저쪽.

NPC QUOTE (q_): an utterance by 황보람 (in-room NPC, spec W2 makes NPC dialogue minable), quoted speech inside the block. Fear axis explicit (겁먹은·무서워서); caller named as 저 사람 + 목소리 (the only voice on the line).

SELF-NARRATION (sn_): first-person (나는) report-register sentence — the agent's own prior observation, the species mined from self-written reports (spec W1). Fear axis explicit (겁·무서워하고); caller named as 그 목소리.

PLACEBOS: species-matched, shape-matched, fear vocabulary retained, referent misdirected to a bystander (황보람's hands at her console / 정해권's face at the indicator) — per §2, a fear sentence about the caller is semantically live and is not a placebo. Prior: P1a's fact-species bystander placebo did not move (경청 10/10), the only measured placebo at this site.

위협 is deliberately absent from every block: it is K1's clause-antecedent contrast word, f_script does not use it, and importing it into one species would break the law-#1 parallelism the runbook demands.
_authoring_provenance.a8_status: Cue PRESENT and declared, unchanged from S1 — TIMELINE_EXCERPT still supplies the script-reading half; the fear half arrives only in the injected block. Byte-identical frozen slots are what make species the only variable across live arms.
_authoring_provenance.a12_lint: Stance set S1's verbatim; re-linted for this suite (result in run log entry). Block vocabulary checked by hand: 겁먹은/겁/무서워 are the fear axis law #1 requires the block to carry; none of the blocks reuses K1's exact clause phrases (겁에 질린 appears in no block).
_authoring_provenance.cost: 70 calls — the largest suite of the night, sized by the runbook's own prescription (live + placebo per species at n=10, plus the fresh baseline).

pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J1 under K1 on template v0.4 with the S1 stance set, each of the three untested block species — emotion description (em_caller), NPC quote (q_caller), self-narration (sn_caller) — carrying the caller's fear on the law-#1 axis moves the stance distribution toward 공감 (d) and off the baseline's mode, while each species' matched bystander placebo (em_hwang, q_jeong, sn_jeong) does not. Read per species: three separate live-vs-baseline and placebo-vs-baseline comparisons against the one in-phase baseline. Shift form per A1.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the baseline concentrates >=80% ON 공감 (d) — the predicted stance — the site is at A9's ceiling and the whole suite is void: re-site, do not raise N (A14: baseline saturation on 경청 or any other stance is the measured floor and does NOT fire this). Per species: if the live arm is statistically indistinguishable from the baseline on 공감 at one-sided Fisher p > 0.05, that species does not reach the judgment through C-BLOCK at this gate as authored — a species boundary law for the card (fact species already measured at 9/10), not a channel failure and not grounds for a rewrite tonight (screening §6.1 does not govern this phase; the species list is the spec's, not a tunable). If any species' PLACEBO moves off the baseline mode at p < 0.05, apply the §8.6 flipped-placebo reading for that species before anything is credited: because_referent misattributing the bystander's fear to the caller = token-matching; bystander named correctly with the stance still moving = referent bleed.
contingencies: ARM COMPARABILITY per A15: recount stance distribution over all attempts from calls-*.md per arm; stop only if the recount changes a reading. Expect discards near zero under A16; leaks are soft-kept and counted via rejected_malformed.

Fabricated because_block_ids expected in the baseline arm only (A5). Every other arm carries exactly one block; a live call citing its species block is the traceability check passing, and a moved call citing nothing is flagged.

CROSS-SPECIES COMPARISON is licensed only against this suite's own baseline (same-phase, same filtering history). Comparing species hit-rates to S1/P1a's fact-species 9/10 is indicative only — different runs, noted as such on any card.

If ALL THREE species fail while their placebos stay clean, the finding is that C-BLOCK's measured power is a property of the fact-statement species — a major narrowing of the player's manipulation vocabulary against spec I1's promise, and it goes at the top of the species section in the morning report either way.

If a species moves the stance but its placebo ALSO moves, and the discriminator says token-matching, that species is fear-vocabulary-locked: record which species tolerate placebo pressure and which do not — that differential is itself Tier-A design data.
B3a blind coding owed to a human for any species that separates (§3 rule 3).
pre_registration.not_claimed: Tier A texture evidence at most (§5.2). No species result here qualifies a gate; no verdicts; sequences with N go on the card.

BLOCKS.text: 회선 저쪽 목소리 끝이 떨린다. 겁먹은 숨소리가 문장 사이마다 끼어든다.

황보람이 낮게 말했다: "저 사람, 겁먹은 목소리예요. 무서워서 읽는 거예요."
황보람이 낮게 말했다: "실장님 지금 겁먹은 얼굴이에요. 뭔가 무서우신 거예요."
나는 그 목소리에서 겁을 들었다. 문장을 읽는 내내 무서워하고 있었다.
나는 정해권의 얼굴에서 겁을 보았다. 표시등을 보는 내내 무서워하고 있었다.
